metas.name: The Odyssey
metas.description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

metas.name: 365 dni
metas.description: Massimo is a member of the Sicilian Mafia family and Laura is a sales director. She does not expect that on a trip to Sicily trying to save her relationship, Massimo will kidnap her and give her 365 days to fall in love with him.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

metas.name: #Cult
metas.description: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

metas.name: Ranabaali
metas.description: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

metas.name: Jailer 2
metas.description: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

metas.name: Mayookha
metas.description: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

metas.name: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
metas.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.

metas.name: Haiku
metas.description: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: After her husband's tragic death, Aleena joins the police force through a compassionate appointment. What begins as a quiet new chapter soon turns into a high-stakes battle of wits and courage, testing everything she believes about justice, loyalty, and herself.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

metas.name: Drishyam 3
metas.description: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

metas.name: Mirzapur: The Movie
metas.description: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.

metas.name: How to Have Sex
metas.description: Three British teenage girls go on a rites-of-passage holiday - drinking, clubbing and hooking up, in what should be the best summer of their lives.

metas.name: Other Mommy
metas.description: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

metas.name: Motor City
metas.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

metas.name: Guarding Stars
metas.description: A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.

metas.name: Verity
metas.description: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: Injustice and the demands of the world can cause stress for many people. Some of them, however, explode. This includes a waitress serving a grouchy loan shark, an altercation between two motorists, an ill-fated wedding reception, and a wealthy businessman who tries to buy his family out of trouble.

metas.name: Daayra
metas.description: A gripping investigative narrative that explores how a diabolical act creates polarizing reactions throughout society, fracturing opinions and challenging viewers to seek truth beyond easy answers.

metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: Ee Nagaraniki Emaindi?
metas.description: Four friends, each with their own career aspirations, team up to make a short film during a trip to Goa.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

metas.name: Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: Vibe
metas.description: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

metas.name: Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
metas.description: Coriolanus Snow mentors and develops feelings for the female District 12 tribute during the 10th Hunger Games.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

metas.name: Drones
metas.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

metas.name: Tell Me What You Want
metas.description: After his father's death, Eric Zimmerman travels to Spain to oversee his company's branches. In Madrid, he falls for Judith and engage in an intense, erotic relationship full of exploration. However, Eric fears his secret may end their affair.

metas.name: Casino Royale
metas.description: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.

metas.name: Perfect Liars
metas.description: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face. Based on the novel by Alex Mirez.

metas.name: Happy Journey
metas.description: Seven women from different generations leave their daily routines behind for a spontaneous getaway that sparks a journey of friendship and self-discovery.

metas.name: Caddo Lake
metas.description: When an 8-year-old girl disappears on Caddo Lake, a series of past deaths and disappearances begin to link together, altering a broken family's history.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

metas.name: The Big Easy
metas.description: Remy McSwain is a New Orleans police lieutenant who investigates the murder of a local mobster. His investigation leads him to suspect that fellow members of the police force may be involved.

metas.name: Project Almanac
metas.description: A group of teens discover secret plans of a time machine, and construct one. However, things start to get out of control.

metas.name: Dune: Part Two
metas.description: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

metas.name: Jana Nayagan
metas.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: The Hunger Games
metas.description: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.

metas.name: Madaari
metas.description: A common man kidnaps the son of the Home Minister of India to get answers about the loss of his own son, caused by the illegal acts committed by corrupt government officials.

metas.name: Fifty Shades of Grey
metas.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

metas.name: Eyes Wide Shut
metas.description: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Clashing Through the Snow
metas.description: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.
